Docket 1.3.159

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes) to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Windows users are no longer told about "this Mac".* Two connection messages (a site that refuses the connection, and no
  network at all) said "this Mac" on every computer. They now say "this computer".
- *Public Site Check preview, more accurate.* The one worked example in the preview is now always a confirmed problem when
  there is one, and says plainly when a person needs to check it. Document dates are read more carefully: US-style dates in
  file names are understood, an ambiguous date is marked for review instead of guessed, and the earliest posting clue wins.
  The board report's counts now include problems found in documents.

99 checks across 13 areas.
